outcome: Postpartum depression (PPD) at 1 and 6 months after childbirth
cohort: 89,954 mothers with a live singleton birth
finding: While cesarean section was marginally associated with PPD at 1 month postpartum overall, this association was stronger among women with antenatal psychological distress.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was marginally associated with PPD at 1 month postpartum but not at 6 months, and this association was stronger among women with antenatal psychological distress.
